title: NotebookLM-for-Windows
tagline: Native Windows wrapper for NotebookLM with session persistence and system-level triggers
techStack: Electron | Vanilla JavaScript | HTML/CSS | auto-launch | IPC-bridge
description: Users of Google's NotebookLM face workflow friction due to its web-bound nature, which lacks session persistence, system-level triggers, and native desktop integration. This results in 'browser clutter' and missing real-time notifications for long-running AI tasks like audio generation.
strategicInsight: Improving the research 'flow' by decoupling a power-user tool from the browser into a dedicated environment, shifting it from a destination website to a persistent productivity utility.
impact: Delivers a seamless, low-latency research experience that actively notifies users of task completion without requiring an open browser tab.
